stem: A paid search ad has a CTR of 6.0% and a display banner for the same TVs has a CTR of 0.4%. What is the soundest reading?

options.text: The banner is failing, since it gets fifteen times fewer clicks per showing
Search ads answer a query just typed, so judge each ad against its own format
The search ad wins more orders, since a larger share of its showings got a click
The banner's CTR is wrong, since display ads are paid per showing, not per click
